content:
lucas: heads-up: noticed staging logs from the node sample app sometimes lack our request id during startup. snippet:
````
INFO starting server
INFO received request path=/health
INFO processed tokens count=12
````
there's no req_id field where it used to be.

ria: did anything change in autoinit order? node SDK recently switched to autoprobing otel, might be triggering log hooks earlier than reqid middleware.

dave: i can repro locally. node sampleapp with OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.0 shows missing reqids maybe 10-30% of cold starts. go and python sampleapps are fine.

lucas: ok so parity problem. probable cause: our reqid attach relies on an opentelemetry hook that only runs when a span exists; if sampler drops internal spans the context never gets the id before the logger emits.

ria: also saw truncated values like "req=----" which looks like the redactor chopping compact uuids when LOG_LEVEL=debug. current redactor regex is too permissive.

ops-bot: quick mitigation: set REDWOOD_REQID_FALLBACK=1 in staging so the logger synthesizes a fallback reqid when none present. Applied to staging cluster fs-2.

dave: suggested fixes:
- make reqid attach independent of otel span lifecycle (attach from raw request headers first)
- reorder node logger hooks so reqid attach runs before any otel initialization code
- tighten redactor regex to strict hyphenated UUID pattern and add an allowlist for traceparent-like headers

ria: i'm prepping a small node patch that moves the reqid hook to the earliest logger hook and adds a unit test that asserts every line during bootstrap contains req_id. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/501 (draft)

lucas: can we add an e2e matrix that runs node+go with OTEL_SAMPLER_PROBABILITY=0.0 and =1.0 to check parity? CI should run both.

ci-bot: opened job matrix job: telemetry-parity-node-go with sampler=[0.0,1.0] loglevel=[info,debug]

dave: redactor change note: current regex `([A-F0-9]{8}-[A-F0-9\-]{20,})` is case-sensitive and grabs fragments. propose `\b[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}\b` and add config flag REDACT_ALLOWLIST for legacy tokens.

ria: i'll include migration note in the docs PR and ping customer-success about potential client impact.

lucas: action items: ria land hook reorder + unit test, dave add e2e matrix, dave/ria update redactor regex and docs. i'll keep the fallback in staging until canary is clean.

ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled: canary-id=telemetry-fix-2026-03-21 to staging at 2026-03-21T09:00:00Z

dave: update after canary: staging looked clean (few missing reqids pre-patch), post-canary no missing reqids in 12h smoke. will monitor. :thumbsup:
